/docs/practice-problems/design-challenge.title: Design Challenge: Real-Time Fraud Detection at 100K Events/Sec
/docs/practice-problems/design-challenge.description: Design a real-time fraud detection system end to end at 100K events/sec with severe class imbalance -- then self-assess against a real rubric and walkthrough.

/docs/practice-problems/design-challenge.title: Design Challenge: A RAG System Over 100M Enterprise Documents
/docs/practice-problems/design-challenge.description: Design a real RAG system end to end for 100M enterprise documents, sub-second latency, and answers that must be right -- then self-assess against a real rubric.

/docs/practice-problems/design-challenge.title: Design Challenge: Personalized Recommendations for a 50M-Item Catalog
/docs/practice-problems/design-challenge.description: Design a personalized recommender for 50M items, handling cold start and feedback-loop bias -- then self-assess your design against a real rubric and walkthrough.

/docs/practice-problems/design-challenge.title: Design Challenge: A Support Agent That Can Actually Take Actions
/docs/practice-problems/design-challenge.description: Design an agent that can look up orders and issue refunds safely at 50K conversations/day -- then self-assess your trust and control design against a real rubric.

/docs/practice-problems/design-lru-cache.title: Practice: Design an LRU Cache
/docs/practice-problems/design-lru-cache.description: Implement an LRU cache from scratch in a real Python sandbox -- get/put in O(1), where every access reorders which key gets evicted next.

/docs/practice-problems/design-min-stack.title: Practice: Design a Min Stack
/docs/practice-problems/design-min-stack.description: Design a MinStack with O(1) push/pop/top/get_min -- the trick is maintaining a running minimum incrementally, not rescanning the stack each call.

/docs/practice-problems/detect-cycle-dir.title: Practice: Detect a Cycle in a Directed Graph
/docs/practice-problems/detect-cycle-dir.description: Detect a cycle in a directed graph via 3-color DFS in a real Python sandbox -- white/gray/black, where a cycle is DFS reaching an already-gray node.

/docs/practice-problems/discounted-retur.title: Practice: Discounted Return From Scratch
/docs/practice-problems/discounted-retur.description: Implement an RL agent's discounted return from scratch -- the sum value functions are trained to predict, and the basis of the Bellman equations.

/docs/practice-problems/k-nearest-neighb.title: Practice: K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) Classifier
/docs/practice-problems/k-nearest-neighb.description: Implement KNN classification using Euclidean distance.

/docs/practice-problems/kmeans-assignmen.title: Practice: K-Means, One Assignment Step
/docs/practice-problems/kmeans-assignmen.description: Implement K-Means' assignment step from scratch: assign each point to its nearest centroid by squared Euclidean distance, ties to the lowest index.

/docs/practice-problems/kmeans-update-st.title: Practice: K-Means, Centroid Update Step

/docs/practice-problems/largest-rectangl.title: Practice: Largest Rectangle in a Skyline
/docs/practice-problems/largest-rectangl.description: Implement largest_rectangle_area(heights) in real O(n) using a monotonic stack -- not the O(n^2) brute-force check of every left/right bound pair.

/docs/practice-problems/layer-normalizat.title: Practice: Layer Normalization From Scratch
/docs/practice-problems/layer-normalizat.description: Implement Layer Normalization from scratch with NumPy for a 2D batch -- the batch-size-independent normalization that's the default in Transformers.

/docs/practice-problems/level-order-trav.title: Practice: Level-Order Traversal (BFS)
/docs/practice-problems/level-order-trav.description: BFS on a binary tree in a real Python sandbox -- visit every node top-to-bottom, left-to-right, exactly the order BFS naturally produces from the root.

/docs/practice-problems/lone-number.title: Practice: The Lone Number
/docs/practice-problems/lone-number.description: Find the one non-duplicated element in a list using only XOR, in O(1) space -- a classic bit-manipulation interview pattern, no hash map needed.

/docs/practice-problems/longest-increasi.title: Practice: Longest Increasing Subsequence
/docs/practice-problems/longest-increasi.description: Implement longest_increasing_subsequence(nums) in real O(n log n) using patience sorting + binary search, not the O(n^2) per-index DP.

/docs/practice-problems/longest-unique-r.title: Practice: Longest Run of Unique Characters
/docs/practice-problems/longest-unique-r.description: Find the longest run of unique characters in a string using the sliding-window pattern in one pass, instead of an O(n^2) or O(n^3) brute-force check.

/docs/practice-problems/lora-linear-laye.title: Practice: LoRA Linear Layer Forward Pass From Scratch
/docs/practice-problems/lora-linear-laye.description: Implement a LoRA-adapted linear layer's forward pass from scratch with NumPy -- the low-rank adapter behind most efficient LLM fine-tuning today.

/docs/practice-problems/lowest-common-an.title: Practice: Lowest Common Ancestor in a Binary Tree
/docs/practice-problems/lowest-common-an.description: Find the lowest common ancestor in a general binary tree via DFS in a real Python sandbox -- no BST ordering to exploit, values assumed unique.
